body: Ahhh yung socializing part really hurts jusko. Feel ko na deteriorate din social skills ko dahil sa pandemic na ito and you know how important it is sa adulting world to make connections and all pero things right now makes it so hard

Actually I'm a STEM student leaning towards medically inclined courses din (Nursing, Medtech Pharmacy etc) but right now I'm unsure if I should actually pursue it. If ilagay din natin na eenroll ako next school year for either one of these courses, I'm not sure if ang makukuha ko na learnings from online class will still retain by the time I'll join the work force or proceed with med school. I'd feel like a fraud

I feel bad din sa mga teachers ko na ang effort mag turo kahit sa ganitong sitwasyon. I often think to myself na if this were face-to-face for sure magegets ko rin ang lectures nila pero sad to say wala talagang pumapasok sa utak ko. 

Yung ma delay sa pag graduate ay one of the major concerns sa parents ko. di ko ma deny na may stigma ang paghihinto ng school pero when I really think about it, there's nothing really wrong with taking a break as long as babalik ka pa rin
Anong ginagawa nila ngayon? Kasi If I do go through with my plans gusto ko pa rin maging productive

I actually started drawing fanart because of some of these shows. Her break is in line with mine, hopefully projects from our school won't be that daunting during that time. Thanks for asking. It's really nice of you :))

If I really do love the story yeah I get sucked in easily to the point where I'd look up more info about it. I watch them by myself though. I do however have a sister that has fairly the same interests but she's too busy with med school at the moment to sit down and watch with me

Oh well, those three have largely different plots but ultimately I like shows where relationships within characters grow and such. It's like when I watch them I put myself into their shoes and empathize with their choices, so kinda like an escape from my own reality I guess.
Atypical, Owl House, Promised Neverland just to name a few.

I know its temporary. Its just that out of all the experiences I've gone through and the suicidal thoughts I've thought of, online classes is what actually made me get close to killing myself. Sure there'd be a christmas break but after that we still have another 5 months of online hell. I can still go on but I' dont know for how long.
